summary: A low-frequency oscillator that moves other machines' parameters: up to 8 targets (any parameter of any machine), each with its own depth, polarity, range and curve, written smoothly and never as an undo step. Seven shapes, a free rate in Hz or a tempo-synced one from 8 bars to 1/64 (straight, dotted or triplet), a phase offset, retrigger on the beat, the bar or a note of a machine, and smoothing. Use it for wobble, filter sweeps, tremolo, vibrato and slow movement on any machine, effects included.
use_for: Move any machine's parameter with a wave: wobble, sweeps, tremolo, vibrato, up to 8 targets, smoothly.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: The wave: sine, triangle, saw up, saw down, square, smooth random or sample and hold
parameters.how: Chooses the wave the modulation follows; the two random shapes pick a new value every cycle, gliding to it or holding it.
parameters.sound: Sine and triangle sway smoothly, saws ramp, square flips between two values, smooth random drifts, sample and hold steps.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Cycles per second when Sync is Free
parameters.how: Sets how fast the wave repeats, from 0.02 to 40 Hz, while Sync is Free.
parameters.sound: A low rate is a slow drift, around 5 Hz is a wobble or vibrato, higher is a fast flutter.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Free: Rate in Hz. Otherwise one cycle lasts this long at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Locks one cycle to a length of the song's tempo, from 8 bars down to 1/64; Free uses Rate in Hz.
parameters.sound: Synced movement stays in time with the music and lines up with the beat.

parameters.name: Feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (1.5 times longer) or triplet (two thirds as long) when Sync is on
parameters.how: Stretches a synced cycle to 1.5 times (dotted) or shrinks it to two thirds (triplet); it only counts while Sync is on.
parameters.sound: Dotted and triplet cycles give the movement a lilting, off-grid pulse against the beat.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: Where in the cycle it starts, and the offset when locked to the song
parameters.how: Shifts the wave forward by 0 to 360 degrees of a cycle.
parameters.sound: Two LFOs at different phases peak at different moments, so their targets move apart.

parameters.name: Retrigger
parameters.description: Free: runs on. Beat or Bar: restarts the cycle each beat or bar. Note: restarts when the listened machine plays a note
parameters.how: Restarts the cycle each beat, each bar or on each note of the machine it listens to; Free lets it run on.
parameters.sound: Retriggered movement starts from the same point every time, so every note or bar gets the same sweep.

parameters.name: Smooth
parameters.description: Rounds the corners of the output (a one-pole of up to half a second)
parameters.how: Rounds off the wave's corners with a lag of up to half a second.
parameters.sound: Square and random shapes glide between their values instead of jumping; a high setting also shrinks fast waves.

parameters.name: Write glide
parameters.description: Time a target takes to cross its whole range: no write moves further than this allows
parameters.how: Limits how fast a target may move: it takes at least this long to cross its whole range.
parameters.sound: A short glide keeps fast modulation clean; a long one smooths it into a slow drift and blunts fast waves.
